settings.headline: Built for the appointment.
settings.body: Senseless is a UK-formulated topical preparation. A topical preparation developed for the way appointments that work on the skin actually run — tattooing, piercings, microneedling, laser, semi-permanent makeup, waxing. Short windows between booking and the chair, sensitive areas, and clients who care about the experience as much as the result.
